reason: PGS005206 passed all technical checks (checksum match to pin DR-0001, 81/81 variants matched, 0 effect-allele mismatches, 20/20 individuals QC PASS on synthetic data), but the Validation Critic refused release (V6b_request_phenotype_correspondence). The score's own PGS Catalog trait fields say only 'Bone mineral density' with no skeletal site; the total-body site comes only from its linked source GWAS (GCST005348, 'Total body bone mineral density'), and the only catalog evaluation is a single European pediatric cohort (Generation R, n=3470). Do you (a) explicitly approve using PGS005206 as a total-body BMD score on the basis of the linked GWAS, accepting these limitations, (b) approve changing the target phenotype to generic 'Bone mineral density', or (c) want the run stopped without released scores, so that an alternative score with an explicit total-body BMD label can be sought in a new run?

task_definition.scoring_requirements: Use the provided score PGS005206 and genotype file inputs/dosages.tsv (20 individuals); the score's phenotype must match total-body BMD, with variant coverage and effect-allele checks passing before calculation, then validation and limitations reporting.
